maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from dealer subscriptions for listings, advertising and digital marketing software, not repair or servicing of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Paid by private auto dealers and manufacturer advertisers; consumers use the marketplace free.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly organically via its marketplace and dealer products, with only occasional acquisitions like Dealer Inspire and FUEL.

mission_critical.reason: Dealers can shift listing and advertising spend to rivals like CarGurus or Autotrader; marketplace is not core operating software.

notes: Dealer website and software products (Dealer Inspire) have some stickiness, but the larger marketplace/advertising part is easy to switch.
